description: Public transit providers lookup: transit agencies for a US metro area from a curated registry. Pass location (city or agency name, required); optional transportation_type (rail, metro, bus, ferry) and trip_style. Returns JSON with matches, each with provider_id, name, transportation modes and a verification URL. The registry is hand-curated and covers a limited set of US metro areas; it does not confirm departures, fares or disruptions. $0.01 via x402; a missing location or no match is refused without charge. This MCP never pays: it returns the live result if the backend answers, or the request URL and x402 payment metadata for a client that can pay.

location.description: City or transit agency name (US metro areas in the curated registry).
